topSites: Fly fishing the Gallatin, Madison & Yellowstone rivers
Hyalite Canyon hikes and the reservoir

housing.intro: Bozeman is the hub: BZN airport, groceries, and the bars are all here, and everything below is inside a two-hour drive. Mid-October is shoulder season — after the summer crush, before Big Sky's ski rates kick in — which is the main reason the numbers work for a group this size.

areas.name: Bozeman / Gallatin Valley
areas.vibe: Walk to Main Street breweries and roll to the airport in 15 minutes. Least scenic, most convenient, and the easiest place to find a big house that actually sleeps 10.

areas.name: Big Sky
areas.vibe: Lone Peak scenery and proper ski-town cabins. Mid-October is dead season here — lifts are closed and rates are at their annual floor, which is either a bargain or a ghost town depending on your mood.

areas.name: Livingston / Paradise Valley
areas.vibe: The postcard option: Emigrant Peak over the Yellowstone River, blue-ribbon fly water out the back door, and the closest good base for a north-gate Yellowstone day.

areas.name: Ennis / Madison Valley
areas.vibe: Fishing-first and genuinely quiet. The Madison is the draw; the town is one street. Cheapest per bedroom of the five, with the least to do if it rains.

areas.name: Gardiner / West Yellowstone
areas.vibe: Right at Yellowstone's gates — worth it only if the park is the whole point. Furthest from the airport and the thinnest restaurant scene, but you're in Lamar Valley at sunrise.

notes: Mid-October is shoulder season — between summer and ski — so this is the cheapest the area gets outside of April.
Snow is possible by mid-October at these elevations. Get a place with a plowed driveway and don't book anything up a forest road.
Anything sleeping 10 usually means 4-5 bedrooms; Airbnb's guest filter counts sofa beds, so check the actual bed list.
Book two vehicles rather than one — nothing at BZN seats 10, and the group will want to split up anyway.
Yellowstone's north entrance (Gardiner) stays open to cars year-round; most interior roads close to cars in early November.
